field_observation_rules.canonical_member_identity_and_affiliatio: Observed only from the exact official roster and member profile bodies.
field_observation_rules.subcommittee_assignment_and_role: Observed only from the three exact official subcommittee membership lists; representation on behalf of a member is retained as represented_member, not direct personal attendance or authorship.
field_observation_rules.agenda_setting_or_chair_authority: Observed only for the committee chair, committee vice chair, and the three published subcommittee chairs.
field_observation_rules.source_identities_and_exact_custody: Observed only through exact route, body, header, artifact, and member-profile custody.
field_observation_rules.meeting_attendance_state: No member-specific attendance is observed from a meeting agenda, roll-call agenda item, or generic statement that committee members met in person.
field_observation_rules.recorded_vote_state_and_vote_identity: No recorded member vote is observed.
field_observation_rules.dissent_concurrence_or_separate_statemen: No member-specific dissent, concurrence, or separate statement is observed; silence is not unanimity.
field_observation_rules.information_access_or_briefing_custody_w: Public webinar and presentation availability do not establish member-specific information access.
field_observation_rules.recommendation_drafting_or_authorship_cu: A subcommittee mandate to research and draft recommendations and a member assignment do not establish individual authorship.
